description: This file contains utility functions related to team management in Mattermost, including default channel names, email domain restrictions, and admin role group checks.

classes.name: TeamService
classes.description: Service class providing team-related utilities and restrictions.

methods.name: DefaultChannelNames
methods.description: Returns default channel names, including experimental default channels if configured.

methods.name: IsEmailAddressAllowed
methods.description: Checks if an email address matches allowed domains.

methods.name: IsTeamEmailAllowed
methods.description: Determines if a user's email is allowed for team creation based on domain restrictions.

methods.name: GetAllowedDomains
methods.description: Retrieves allowed email domains for a user and team.

methods.name: checkValidDomains
methods.description: Validates that team allowed domains are within the permitted list.

methods.name: normalizeDomains
methods.description: Normalizes domain strings by removing '@' and ',' characters and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: userIsInAdminRoleGroup
methods.description: Checks if a user belongs to any admin role groups for a given syncable.
